messages:
alex: Heads up — pushed a new Cache Pulseboard for prefix/prompt cache hit-rate (per-model / per-route / per-customer). Dashboard link: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/abc123/cache-pulseboard — please eyeball token-saved calc, I think long prompts look undercounted.

jia: looks good at a glance. I see a dip around 03:45 UTC on prod. did something land then?

alex: yeah merged a kernel-selection tweak to the canary at ~03:40 (PR 3421). suspect batching heuristics changed KV key alignment -> more misses.

omar: profiling attached to the board shows a kernel-selection shift and a spike in prefix-eviction rate. quick check I ran: `rate(prefix_cache_misses_total[5m])` jumped vs baseline.

lina: can we get slices by seq-length buckets (<=512, 513-2048, >2048)? hits look fine for short seqs but drop for long ones.

kevin: FYI ops-bot fired a prefetch-hitrate alert at 03:47, but it might be noisy for tiny tenants.

ops-bot: Alert: prefetch.hitrate.aggregation breached on prod-cluster-3 at 2025-11-15T03:47:22Z (hit-rate dropped >15% over 10m). Rule: prefetch.hitrate.aggregation.

alex: action items: jia to revert kernel gating on canary (owner: jia). omar to add seq-length buckets + tenant-slicing panels (owner: omar). lina to add smoothing options (15m/1h) and deploy annotations (owner: lina). kevin to update alert to ignore tenants <50k tokens/day (owner: kevin).

jia: starting rollback now, will post completion time. ptp logs show rollback in progress on canary hosts.

omar: added seq-bucket panels and a token-saved waterfall by tenant. also added a hover text for token-saved calculation. PromQL used for token-saved pct (example):
```promql
sum by(tenant,model,route)(rate(prefix_cache_saved_tokens_total[5m]))
/ sum by(tenant,model,route)(rate(requested_tokens_total[5m]))
```

lina: pushed 15m smoothing and deploy annotations to the board; added per-route heatmap. will promote to main in 10m.

kevin: adjusted alert in staging to exclude low-volume tenants with `unless sum by(tenant)(rate(requested_tokens_total[1d])) < 50000`. testing now.

alex: thanks all — we'll monitor for 2h post-rollback and then decide on kernel change next steps. :thumbsup:
